question: Which materials for vessels are enumerated in response to the goddess?
premises: Vessels made of clay are mentioned.
A vessel of tortoise origin is mentioned.
Vessels of bell metal and copper metal are mentioned.
inference: Acceptable vessels include those made of clay, tortoise-derived material, bell metal, and copper metal.
plain_english: O goddess, vessels may be made of clay, born of a tortoise, made of bell metal, or made of copper.
